18-collapsible-tree-search.visual_critic_note: Deliberate Paul Tol palette and polished search/tooltip interactions show real design intent, but the default view leaves the bottom half of the viewport empty, and typographic hierarchy is minimal beyond functional size differences.
18-collapsible-tree-search.encoding_integrity_note: Tree correctly encodes hierarchy via position and rank via categorical color with no quantitative encoding violations; minor robustness gap from name+depth join keys instead of stable IDs, and a hardcoded minimum SVG width of 1200px, but neither causes deception.
18-collapsible-tree-search.stress_test_note: No .interrupt() call before starting new transitions in toggle(), setAllExpanded(), or updateSearch(), so rapid clicks or expand-all during a 500ms animation will cause overlapping/conflicting transitions; all other criteria pass cleanly — search is debounced at 200ms, pointer events unify mouse/touch, no brush/zoom means no Update Storm or Stale Scale risk, and no cross-view dispatch means no Infinite Loop risk.
18-collapsible-tree-search.cognitive_load_note: Clean progressive disclosure with sensible default depth, 6-color rank legend maps unambiguously to node colors, collapsed badge counts (+37 etc.) give context without overwhelming, and search+highlight path reduces navigation load — animation quality can't be assessed from static screenshot.
